verses.text: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John, James’s brother, up a high mountain by themselves. 🏔️
Right in front of them, Jesus was transformed. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes turned bright as light.
Then Moses and Elijah appeared, talking with him.
Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it’s good we’re here. If you want, I’ll set up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
While Peter was still talking, a bright cloud covered them. A voice came from the cloud: “This is my beloved Son, who makes me glad. Listen to him.”
When the disciples heard that, they dropped face-down and were terrified.
Jesus came over, touched them, and said, “Get up. Don’t be afraid.”
They looked up and saw no one but Jesus.
As they came down the mountain, Jesus told them, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”
The disciples asked him, “Why do the teachers of the Law say Elijah has to come first?”
Jesus answered, “Elijah does come first and will set everything right.”
“But I’m telling you, Elijah already came, and they didn’t recognize him. They did whatever they wanted to him. The Son of Man will suffer at their hands too.”
Then the disciples understood he was talking about John the Baptizer.
When they came back to the crowd, a man approached Jesus, knelt before him, and said:
“Lord, have mercy on my son. He has seizures and suffers badly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.”
“I brought him to your disciples, but they couldn’t heal him.”
Jesus answered, “You faithless, twisted generation! How long do I have to stay with you? How long must I put up with this? Bring the boy here to me.”
Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy. He was healed that very moment.
Then the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

He told them, “Because your faith is too small. I’m telling you the truth: if you have faith even the size of a mustard seed, you can tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it’ll move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
“But this kind doesn’t come out except through prayer and fasting.”
While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be handed over to people.”
“They’ll kill him, and on the third day he’ll be raised.” The disciples were deeply grieved.
When they arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Your teacher pays the temple tax, right?”
Peter said, “Yes.” When he went into the house, Jesus spoke first: “What do you think, Simon? Who do earthly kings collect taxes and tribute from—their own children or strangers?”
Peter answered, “Strangers.” Jesus said, “Then the children are exempt.”
“But so we don’t trip them up, go to the sea and cast a hook. Take the first fish you catch. Open its mouth and you’ll find a stater coin. Give it to them for you and me.” 🐟
